proposed_function: Low-complexity amino acid sequence with no predicted secondary structure, part of the intrinsically disordered regions of the protein.
evidence: Outside of its YTH domain, Mmi1 is primarily comprised of low-complexity amino acid sequence (residues 1–347) with no predicted secondary structure (Fig. 1A).
curator_note: Exact positions given (1-347). This annotation describes the general IDR composition rather than a specific binding interface, but it is the primary LCR context for the protein.
